label: r3c4
name: r1c1 recipe, entropy 0.01
hypothesis: This keeps r1c1 exactly but doubles ent_coef from 0.005 to 0.01. The weak seeds had low training success, which points to slow learning, possibly from committing early to a poor policy over 257 actions. More entropy keeps exploration going while the frame mixture settles, and should lift the seed minimum. It is refuted if the mean falls below 0.90 or training success falls, which would mean the extra entropy only blurs the greedy policy.
